reviews.review:
it is a fun hack'n'sla.. well hack'n'shoot, but don't expect too much. Honestly, I expected more. 
I had fun playing it, but that's pretty much it. Multiple times through it, I paused just to read a bit or something, because it kinda seemed a better use for my time.
EDIT: decided to change upvote to downvote. steam only lets me thumb up or down, not, well, sideways, and I would have given this a neutral rating. I even had it at positive at first, but with that many reviews acting like it was the best game ever, a downvote seems more in place.
Just keep in mind when reading this.

I think one of my main annoyances is that the escape roll in combat is severely.. well not bugged but useless. enemies in their dying animation still block your way, so if you're surrounded and killed one, you have to wait 1-2 precious seconds to be able to escape. also, the big bad space marine does not manage to jump over the tiniest differences in height. A knee height barrier out of sandbags is impossible to get through even with the escape jumproll, and because of the camera that is so zoomed in that you can't see anything below your waist in many situations, it can often happen that such obstacles are out of your view. Nothing more annoying than trying to roll to safety, only to roll in place because there is a wall you weren't able to see.
Also, your attack animation does not get aborted if you try to roll, meaning often if you see the enemy wind up, hit roll, and get to watch you being hit anyway because it ignores your command.

stuff like this means that I mainly went at it with the guns.. Which were pretty lame. Only really 4 of the 10 or so weapons were really useable. You get stuff like "vengeance launcher" which is a grenade launcher that doesn't do much damage, has a puny damage area and you have to manually trigger each shot with the reload button. Or the storm bolter which looks and acts like a minigun, but actually does very little damage (I once unloaded like 4 magazines into a chaos trooper and he still stood, while two shots out of the plasma cannon kills one. I guess just headshotting with the normal bolter would have done more damage)
90% of the game, you'll probably use the basic bolter, switching to plasma cannon, lascannon or meltagun in special situations, and that's it

The environment is also boring as hell. It's always the same. While great at first because I dig the art direction it gets old fast.

Oh and another thing. There are no health packs, health stations etc, the only way to regain health is by stunning an enemy and doing a finisher move. That would have been all well and good.. but you don't get any invincibility during the finishers and they take a long ass time. So if you're nearly dead and have stunned an enemy, you better not use a finisher to regain some health because you're a sitting duck during it and pretty much dead.
Oh and the stunning move does damage, so you'll often really low on health, waited for only one enemy to remain.. only to kill it instead of stun it.

all in all, get this game if you're a warcraft fan or like over the shoulder shooters with heavy focus on melee, but don't expect too much.
As said, I'd give this a neutral rating if I only could
By the far the best representation of the Ultramarines made so popular by Graham McNeil. Not stop action through both ranged and melee violence. The story is all right but the combat shines.

A classic.
One of the best Warhammer 40K games out there.
An excellent FPS.
And the multiplayer was so fun it drew in even me... and I'm singleplayer orientated.

A must-buy for Warhammer 40K fans and people looking for a fun scifi shooter.
A very fun game since who does'nt love to purge a forge world from Xenos and Heretics

All around a very solid genocide simulator. The campaign is quintessential Warhammer 40K, for all the good or bad implications that may mean to you. The campaign certainly sets the mood and has some great settings. It can be somewhat challenging on the hard difficulty so you have to be careful. There is not a large online community but you can find people to play with most of the time with not much wait. The co-op mode (Exterminatus) is enjoyable and satisfying and leaves little room for error in the later phases, though the lack of maps is disapointing. I have not played the versus mode much so I have no opinion. If you know nothing about Warhammer and just want a well made and polished action game in a futuristic/fantasy setting, this is very well worth it.
